# R32 evidence pointer index
This directory contains the independent review inputs used to classify R32 findings. The review files establish the finding and required revision; they do not establish implementation, exercise/measurement, or owner acceptance.

## R32-001
- Finding source: `inputs/02-DETAILED-FEEDBACK.txt:122-129`. - Package evidence: `../../manifest/package-manifest.yaml`, `../../manifest/package-manifest.json`, and the included companion trees under `../../build-spec/` and `../../contracts/`. - Check: `python3 handbook/chd32/scripts/check_package_inputs.py` from the repository root. - Boundary: package resolution and digest verification are specification/package checks only.

## R32-017
- Finding source: `inputs/02-DETAILED-FEEDBACK.txt:298-301`. - Normative runbook: `../../runbooks/controller-backup-restore.md`. - Backup manifest schema: `../../schemas/controller-backup-manifest.schema.json`. - Isolated restore drill: `../../examples/archive/wf08-host-loss-restore/README.md`, `backup-manifest.json`, and `restore-report.json`. - Boundary: this is specification and package evidence; implementation, exercise/measurement, and owner acceptance remain separate.

## R32-025
- Finding source: `inputs/02-DETAILED-FEEDBACK.txt:386-396`. - Machine-checkable disposition table: `../../register/disposition.csv` (27 unique R32 rows). - Independent status schema: `../../status.schema.json` with six non-implying boolean dimensions. - Open register: `../../register/open-items.csv` (2 rows); the generated index must report the same count. - Boundary: a finding citation or source cross-check is not a closure; implementation, exercised/measured, and owner acceptance remain separate.

## Open-item register
`open-items.csv` is the count authority for unresolved design constraints. The index count is derived from its data rows, not hand-entered. Current open count is 2.

## Evidence status vocabulary
`specified`, `internally_checked`, `source_cross_checked`, `implemented`, `exercised_measured`, and `owner_accepted` are independent. A true value in one column never implies any other value.

## Review source limits
`inputs/03-REVIEW-LOG.json` and `inputs/02-DETAILED-FEEDBACK.txt` are source-cross-check evidence. They do not claim a runtime probe, live deployment, implementation, exercise/measurement, or owner acceptance.

## OPEN-VOLD-1
Temporary-agent defaults are explicitly unresolved pending an owner decision and a complete contract.

## OPEN-ARCHIVE-1
Native Hermes export/import capability and archive-retention policy remain probe/owner work; no guessed format or runtime capability is claimed.
